newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian convicted of wildlife killing-agency.
newsitem.headline: Russian convicted of wildlife killing-agency.

text.p: A Russian court has sentenced a man to five years in a labour camp for killing a rare leopard, Interfax news agency said on Thursday, calling it the first conviction in Russia for a crime against a protected species.

Interfax said the court in the far eastern Primorsky region, around the Pacific port of Vladivostok, found Dmitry Pestsov guilty of shooting the female leopard while it was caged at a local wildlife park ahead of shipment to Moscow zoo.
The agency did not specify exactly which breed the animal belonged to but said there were only 10 of them in captivity around the world.
